label: Contractive borrowed-power zero obstruction and recursive applicability walk
summary:
Continuation proves weighted-network finite input paths, nonuniform vanishing-tail zero criterion, positive lower bounds on nonuniform cumulative products, whole-network binary/nonuniform/unbounded fixed points and finite shared-resource budget conservation. Conservative circulation survives finite resource accounting; universal aggregate loss and productive-input-to-independent-being remain without independent warrant. Full proposed judgment, exact scopes, failed unrestricted iteration, blockers and next discriminating test persist in docs/notes/contractive-borrowed-power-1378.md. No root discharge or new floor. Finite throughput plus one positive transfer without a return path now forces an upstream net exporter, even with infinite branching. Grounded export coverage on the actual roster yields a root. Allowing the ledger to be fitted freely gives exactly root existence with a second actual bearer. The same note compares the successor and swap rivals, physical storage, inventory and the outstanding existential applicability test. Ordinal comparison of giver and recipients fails to calibrate the export balance even under preservation and least-upper-bound degree assignment. For a finite histogram, coverage under every positive integer regrading is equivalent to coverage of all upper-threshold counts. The local receipt-matching root route dispenses with numerical distances but requires grounded bearers to admit distinct receipts and a one-way transfer with finite selected export ancestry. Repeated use of one form challenges the existential interpretation; see the same note. The same attenuation theorem has an exact De ente actual-esse specialization yielding 20babef7, conditional on an open quantitative premise. The application section compares bounded lossless forwarding and the equal actual-supply burden for a primitive whole and an independent source. On any countable actual roster, fitting all amounts and weights is equivalent to rootedness of its supplier-closed collections. With positive amounts fixed independently on a two-bearer, one-edge graph, the same laws hold for some weights precisely when the recipient has less. A retained form can be given to multiple recipients; the prior evidential objection to treating every transmission of esse as a loss still applies. Independent semantic review accepted both attenuation findings at 090ea20b4c62f72952458b8885fb02a76e6bc804.

Curation pass 2, lane D batch 4 (#2103, 2026-11-27). 531adda1 remains unplaced. The relay retains the three transfer edges and the same feature possession. Its incoming and outgoing booked totals are 3 and 4 at high grade 3, and 5 and 4 at high grade 5. The incoming-coverage inequality for that booked ledger changes with the grade. The certificate supplies no event-wise `GroundedCanMatch` model over an actual concrete support profile.
